The US presidents, I note, did not always like this statement — but they respected it.

¢ Inthe same token, I told members of the cabinet more than once — "we must always remember that the US is also a sovereign state. And it expects us to respect its right to form its positions on the issues crucial to it, based on its own interests ". And we have to respect that.

¢ Without derogating from our responsibility to make and execute sovereign decisions — the reality is that there isn't full symmetry here.
